integrity_notes: All listed integer invariants are checked by two complete, independently constructed, standard-library-only finite programs. No independent external audit or validation has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite theorem for the 14-vertex Heawood graph only; no arbitrary cubic-graph or higher-plane extension.
The main 2016 prior article on optimal-code ensembles was only accessible in abstract, leaving a genuine historical priority risk.
The large-component connectivity and diameter are proved by complete reproducible finite enumeration rather than by a short noncomputational invariant.
title: Three exchange components of optimal identifying codes in the Heawood graph
